faqs.question: What is the Bandaje Falls Trek?
faqs.answer: The Bandaje Falls Trek is an 18 km round trip trek inside the Kudremukh Forest Range in Dakshina Kannada, Karnataka. The trail passes the ruins of Ballalarayana Durga Fort before descending to Bandaje Falls — a 200-foot waterfall in a protected forest gorge.

faqs.question: How long is the Bandaje Falls Trek?
faqs.answer: The Bandaje Falls Trek is 18 km round trip, completed in 7–8 hours of active trekking on Day 1.

faqs.question: What is the difficulty level of Bandaje Falls Trek?
faqs.answer: Moderate. The climb to Ballalarayana Durga Fort is steep, the descent to the falls is rocky, and stream crossings are common. Suitable for beginners with basic fitness.

faqs.question: What is the maximum altitude of Bandaje Falls Trek?
faqs.answer: The maximum altitude on the Bandaje Falls Trek is 1,500 m (4,921 ft), reached near the Ballalarayana Durga Fort section.

faqs.question: What is the height of Bandaje Falls?
faqs.answer: Bandaje Falls is approximately 200 feet (60 metres) tall — a powerful cascade dropping into a natural rock pool deep inside the Kudremukh Forest.

faqs.question: Is Bandaje Falls Trek suitable for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, with basic fitness. No prior trekking experience is required. The trail has steep and rocky sections but no technical climbing. Regular walking or exercise preparation helps.

faqs.question: What is the best time for Bandaje Falls Trek?
faqs.answer: October to February is the best time. The falls are at full flow post-monsoon (October–November) and the weather is cool and clear through winter (December–February).

faqs.question: Where does the Bandaje Falls Trek start?
faqs.answer: The trek starts from Sunkasale village near Ujire in Dakshina Kannada district, Karnataka.

faqs.question: How far is Bandaje Falls from Bangalore?
faqs.answer: Approximately 290–300 km from Bangalore — around 6–7 hours by road. The trek is done as an overnight trip from Bangalore. 10 What is Ballalarayana Durga Fort? Ballalarayana Durga is a 15th-century hilltop fort located midway on the Bandaje Falls Trek trail. It sits at elevation with panoramic views of the Kudremukh range and is one of the unique historical highlights of this trek. 11 Is Bandaje Falls Trek safe for solo women trekkers? Yes. All batches have a certified trek leader, are capped at 10 trekkers, and follow established forest department-permitted routes. The trek operates in a structured group format throughout. 12 What should I carry for Bandaje Falls Trek? Trekking shoes, rucksack, 2–3 litres of water, poncho, quick-dry clothes, headlamp, sunscreen, personal medications, and a valid ID. A trekking pole is recommended for the descent. 13 Is mobile network available on the Bandaje Falls Trek? Very limited, especially inside the forest zone. Inform family before departure. Emergency communication is managed by the trek leader. 14 What is included in the Bandaje Falls Trek package? The ₹2,999 package includes transport from Bangalore, forest permits, certified guide, homestay accommodation, and all meals on Day 1 plus breakfast on Day 2. 15 How do I book the Bandaje Falls Trek from Bangalore? Book directly on jungletour.in. Select your batch date, fill the booking form, and confirm your spot. Batch size is capped at 10 — early booking is recommended.
